name: Bunkyō (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Bunkyō ward emblem in white: a stylised device of a disc and angular strokes, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Bunkyō, a ward in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 March 1951.

features.role: Bunkyō ward emblem — a stylised device of a disc and angular strokes, like a stylised character
